_doc: Wave-2 cross-lane contract fixture (merged plan §3 contract 4): the migrate-state.json tier fields lane A WRITES and lane B's gate READS. Tests in both lanes load this file so the strings can never drift apart; the closed vocabularies live in Offramp::TIER_VALUES / Offramp::TIER_BASIS (shared/lib/offramp.rb) and test-wave1-vocab-decisions.rb pins this fixture against them.
